# Ocren

> Ocren (オークレン) is a reading-notes app for iPhone and iPad by YenSense, Inc. Photograph a book page, select the lines you want to keep, and Ocren turns them into text with on-device text recognition and saves them as memos with the book and the page number, so you always know which book a line came from.

- Reads Japanese text written vertically or horizontally, and English text written horizontally; picks up the page number from the photo
- Text recognition runs entirely on the device: photos and recognized text are not uploaded, and photos are not saved. Saved memos are stored in the user's account (Sign in with Apple or Google) and sync across devices
- Search all memos by their words, a note, or a book title; notes and seven colored flags; a memo across pages, or several memos from one photo; e-book screenshots from Photos
- Wooden bookshelf with Reading, Read and Want to read; Quote of the day with a daily reminder; Ranking compiled from readers' shelves (only counts are shown)
- Quote cards: put a passage with its book's title and author on paper, wood, or your own photo or video, and share it as an image or as a video for Reels and Stories (the first 15 seconds of a video, or a photo with a slow 10-second zoom). The photos and videos you choose stay on the device
- Free with ads; optional Remove Ads subscription (monthly or yearly). iPhone with iOS 17 or later, iPad with iPadOS 17 or later. App in English and Japanese. App Store category: Productivity
- Contact: ocren-support@yensense.com
